integrity: Exact mathematical proof in RESULT.md and bounded exact-integer check in verify.py. The finite check is not used as proof of the infinite classification.
scientific_limitations: Only complement-closed representations of 2^a p^2 for a>=1, odd p prime, with at most two omitted complement orbits are classified; no existence for larger omissions, and no complete bibliography or external audit is claimed.
title: A two-orbit rigidity theorem for strongly pseudoperfect prime squares
